request.prompt: RimWorld creature sprite, a barbslinger: a calf-sized, heavy, low-slung armoured scorpion, painted realistically in vanilla RimWorld's painterly style with a thin dark outline, varied chitin texture, subtle specular highlights, transparent background. Body: one broad, flat shield plate overhangs the body and legs on every side like a tortoise shell, wider than the segmented body beneath it. The chitin is dark charcoal and smoky bronze, heat-cured and fire-hardened, with a burnished, heat-tempered sheen on the ridges, scorch-blackened edges and grey ash caught in the seams. Small dull eyes are set into the armour at the front of the head. Two broad, shovel-like pincers are held low at the front, built for turning over ash and ground, their tips dusted pale grey with ash. Sturdy jointed legs bend under the shield rim. A single heavy segmented tail rises from the rear end of the body and arches over the back, ending in a knotted cluster of five to seven backward-hooked barbs fanned around the end segment, clearly a bundle of points rather than one stinger. Facings, all showing the same creature turned with its body: south is a front view at a low angle, with the head and pincers large in the foreground, the shield rising behind them foreshortened, and the tail arching up over the top. North is a rear view, seen from behind, showing the shield, rear legs and the tail base foreshortened toward the camera, with the pincers peeking out past the body and the eyes hidden. East is a side profile at ground level, showing the flat shield rim, the pincers forward of the head, the legs bent under the shield, and the tail rising from the rear end and arching over the back. Reference: none; build the body from this description.
